name: @agent-issues/api-local
description: Local SQLite storage engine and daemon JSON-RPC server (the local mirror of @agent-issues/api-pg's cloud Postgres service).

scripts.build: node --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.benchmark:search: pnpm --filter @agent-issues/core build && pnpm run build && node ./scripts/benchmark-search.mjs
